headline: South Africa petrol and diesel prices projected to drop in November
summary: South African fuel prices are expected to decline by up to R1.65 per liter starting November 4, according to Central Energy Fund estimates, despite crude price pressures.
why: Fuel prices directly influence headline inflation, household expenditure, and transport sector logistics across South Africa.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Lower retail fuel prices help reduce consumer price index pressure and transport inputs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
